content:
nina_cs: Quick flag — HelixCorp renewal: they want split billing (Helix US / Helix EU), CC for onboarding fee, procurement wants PO for the remainder. EU procurement also requests an e-witness clause. Can we proceed?

sam_sales: Positive signal. They accept the quoted price for 12 months if we accept split billing. PO ETA ~4 business days, they said CC for onboarding is fine to start.

jo_fin: Finance can accept CC for the onboarding fee (auth hold) but needs PO within 5 business days. Please provide vendor codes + VAT/tax IDs. We'll set invoice metadata: `po: TBD` and `deposit_method: card_auth`.

michael_legal: e-witness looks acceptable. I'll add a short addendum clause: "For EU entity, e-witness (name + email logged) satisfies witnessing requirement." Any objections?

nina_cs: I'll ask buyer to confirm e-witness OK and request vendor codes. Message sent.

(docusign-bot): Template match: "Renewal-Split-Billing-EWitness" available. Reply `create envelope` to generate envelope with witness field and invoice metadata fields.

sam_sales: Buyer confirms e-witness ok and will send vendor codes and PO next week. They want us to charge onboarding CC today.

jo_fin: Approved to charge onboarding amount after doc sign. Finance will finalize invoice once PO arrives and will note: "Provisioning conditional on PO upload within 5 business days."

michael_legal: Addendum text approved. Please capture procurement email on the envelope for audit trail.

nina_cs: Plan: create DocuSign envelope with e-witness addendum + split billing fields, send to buyer, charge CC after signature. Proceeding now unless objections.

docusign-bot: Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0x11-helix-split. Routing: Helix EU signer (witness field) -> Helix US signer -> finance ack.

sam_sales: Sent. I'll nudge procurement for PO.

nina_cs: Thanks all — I'll update thread when signed or when PO lands. :white_check_mark:
